needed.evidence: A wide grass verge runs from the road edge to the houses with no paved or trodden path for pedestrians.
needed.suggestion: Construct a continuous paved footway along the left verge to give residents a safe place to walk away from the carriageway.

needed.evidence: The right side is open grass and trees with no path, so pedestrians would have to walk in the road.
needed.suggestion: Provide a footway on the right side to connect the driveways and give walkers a safe route off the road.

needed.evidence: Homes and driveways on both sides create a reason to cross, but there is no marked or raised crossing anywhere in view.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked pedestrian crossing at the junction of the two side roads to give residents a defined, visible place to cross.
